chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:

I asked him about Ramadan: how much should one pray in it? He said: As he prays in other than it, except that Ramadan has over the rest of the months such virtue that it is appropriate for the servant to increase in his voluntary prayers. So if he wishes and is able to do that, then from the first night of the month until twenty nights, every night he should add twenty rak'ahs besides what he used to pray before that; of these twenty, twelve rak'ahs are between al-Maghrib and al-'Atamah, and eight rak'ahs are after al-'Atamah.

Then he prays the night prayer that he used to pray before that: eight rak'ahs, and al-Witr, three rak'ahs—two rak'ahs in which he gives salām, then he rises and prays one rak'ah in which he recites qunūt; this is al-Witr. Then he prays the two rak'ahs of al-Fajr when dawn breaks, and these are thirteen rak'ahs.

Then when ten nights remain of Ramadan, he should pray thirty rak'ahs every night besides these thirteen rak'ahs: he prays twenty-two rak'ahs between al-Maghrib and al-'Isha', and eight rak'ahs after al-'Atamah. Then after the night prayer he prays thirteen rak'ahs as I described.

And on the night of the twenty-first and the twenty-third, in each one of them, if he is able to do so, he prays one hundred rak'ahs besides these thirteen rak'ahs. And he should stay awake in those two until morning, for it is recommended that this be in prayer, du'a, and humble supplication, for it is hoped that Laylat al-Qadr may be in one of them.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: Dawn; also the time of the two rak'ahs prayed at daybreak.
key_terms.الْوَتْرُ: The final odd-numbered unit of the night prayer, described here as concluding the set.
key_terms.تَطَوُّعِهِ: One's voluntary devotional prayers performed in addition to obligatory acts.
key_terms.دُعَاءٍ: Supplication directed to Allah during the blessed nights.
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The month of Ramadan, distinguished here by greater spiritual merit than other months.
key_terms.صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ: The night prayer regularly performed during the late night hours.
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Decree, hoped to fall on one of the specified nights.

ai.seo_question: How many recommended prayers should be performed in Ramadan according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith outlines the recommended increase in voluntary salat (prayer) during the month of Ramadan, especially in its final ten nights. It also highlights the special merit of the twenty-first and twenty-third nights, encouraging extended worship, du'a, and humble devotion in hope of attaining Laylat al-Qadr.
